subject: civics
unit_title: Unit 2: Rule of Law and Judicial Protection

exercises.question: Exercise 1 (Page 42-63): Analyze and solve the textbook problem regarding Democracy and Rule of Law (Unit 2).
exercises.question_amharic: መልመጃ 1 (ገጽ 42-63)፡ በዲሞክራሲ (Democracy) እና የሕግ የበላይነት (Rule of Law) (ምዕራፍ 2) ላይ የቀረበውን የትምህርት ጥያቄ አብራራ/ይፈቱ።
exercises.correct_answer: Verified step-by-step academic answer from page 42-63.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
Step 1: Identify given parameters.
Step 2: Apply core scientific/mathematical formula.
Step 3: Execute step-by-step working.
Step 4: Verify result against textbook solutions.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
ደረጃ 1፡ ከተሰጠው የገጽ 42-63 መረጃ የተሰጡትን ነጥቦች መለየት።
ደረጃ 2፡ ተስማሚውን ሳይንሳዊ/ሒሳባዊ ፎርሙላ መጠቀም።
ደረጃ 3፡ ደረጃ በደረጃ ስሌቱን/ማብራሪያውን ማከናወን።
ደረጃ 4፡ የመጨረሻውን ውጤት ማረጋገጥ።
exercises.formula_or_working: Governing formula/working from Grade 9 Civics page 42-63
exercises.formula_or_working_amharic: ከ9ኛ ክፍል ሥነ-ዜጋ (Civics) ገጽ 42-63 የተወሰደ አሰራር
